import pandas as pd


def run(inputs: dict) -> dict:
    df = inputs["payments"].copy()

    # Ensure columns exist and preserve original dtypes/order
    cols = ["payment_id", "amount", "currency", "country"]
    df = df[cols]

    n = len(df)
    rejected = pd.Series(False, index=df.index)
    reason_code = pd.Series([None] * n, index=df.index, dtype=object)

    valid_currencies = {"USD", "EUR", "GBP"}

    # R1: amount IS NULL
    mask_r1 = (~rejected) & df["amount"].isna()
    reason_code[mask_r1] = "AMT_NULL"
    rejected = rejected | mask_r1

    # R2: amount <= 0
    mask_r2 = (~rejected) & (df["amount"] <= 0)
    reason_code[mask_r2] = "AMT_NONPOS"
    rejected = rejected | mask_r2

    # R3: currency NOT IN ('USD','EUR','GBP')
    # SQL three-valued logic: if currency is NULL, "NOT IN" evaluates to NULL
    # (unknown), which does not satisfy the condition -> rule does not fire.
    currency_notna = df["currency"].notna()
    mask_r3 = (
        (~rejected)
        & currency_notna
        & (~df["currency"].isin(valid_currencies))
    )
    reason_code[mask_r3] = "CCY_INVALID"
    rejected = rejected | mask_r3

    # R4: country IS NULL
    mask_r4 = (~rejected) & df["country"].isna()
    reason_code[mask_r4] = "CTRY_NULL"
    rejected = rejected | mask_r4

    # Build reject output: original amount preserved, with reason_code
    rejects_df = df.loc[rejected].copy()
    rejects_df["reason_code"] = reason_code.loc[rejected]
    rejects_df = rejects_df[["payment_id", "amount", "currency", "country", "reason_code"]]

    # Build clean output: passing records, amount rounded to 2 decimals
    clean_df = df.loc[~rejected].copy()
    clean_df["amount"] = clean_df["amount"].round(2)
    clean_df = clean_df[["payment_id", "amount", "currency", "country"]]

    return {
        "payments_clean": clean_df.reset_index(drop=True),
        "payments_rejects": rejects_df.reset_index(drop=True),
    }
